title: Glowberry Expansion The Modpack
description: The official modpack for Glowberry Expansion
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd01ea0d09c7495c7434fafca1bf4ea373d83028.png)

Glowberry Expansion The Modpack is a cozy adventure modpack centered around the mod Glowberry Expansion. It has 25+ custom quests and 45+ mods, including Supplementaries, Oculus(for shader support), Waystones(for fast travel) and a bunch of QOL mods.
